entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The largest and oldest fortress city of the Abzan clan on Tarkir, built on an oasis.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir whose society centers on family, fortification and ancestral tradition.

entities.name: Shifting Wastes
entities.description: A dry and ever-changing region of steppes and deserts containing Arashin.

entities.name: Great Aerie
entities.description: A giant fortress structure at the core of Arashin that once served as Dromoka's seat of power.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord who ruled the Abzan, outlawing necromancy and destroying Kin-Trees, and who was defeated.

entities.name: Kin-Trees
entities.description: Trees bonded to Abzan kin-houses that tie the people to their ancestors.

entities.name: Abzan rebellion
entities.description: A rebellion against Dromoka's rule during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Abzan rebellion arose.

entities.name: Felothar Zanhar
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan who leads the Council of Houses.

events.summary: Dromoka rules over the Abzan from the Great Aerie, outlawing necromancy and destroying Kin-Trees to sever ties to ancestors.
events.quote: outlawing necromancy and destroying Kin-Trees to sever the people’s ties to their ancestors

events.summary: The Abzan rebellion rises during the New Phyrexian Invasion and Dromoka is defeated.
events.quote: After Dromoka’s defeat, the fortress city was reclaimed

events.summary: Arashin is transformed into the spiritual and political center of the revived Abzan clan.
events.quote: transformed into the spiritual and political center of the revived Abzan clan

relations.note: Arashin stands within the Shifting Wastes.
The Council of Houses is led by Khan Felothar Zanhar.

relations.quote: the era when Dromoka ruled over the Abzan
